curb_weight_kg.notes: Guide Auto lists "Weight" 1,688 kg (3,721 lb) for the Canadian 2026 Niro EV Wind (64.8 kWh, 17-inch); presumed curb weight. Other Canadian Niro EV trims may weigh slightly more; the variant has one trim.

consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Test: 120 km/h steady, 11 °C, dry, 17-inch wheels (215/55-17 Continental EC6, summer tyres), battery-side (car display; sheet does not say explicitly) | Nyland, 'Kia Niro EV' (second-generation SG2, 64.3 kWh measured; 64.8 kWh gross pack). Guide Auto (Canada) lists the 2026 Niro EV Wind at 64.8 kWh with 17-inch wheels, which matches; note our variant shows usable 68.4 kWh from the Chargeprice archive, which looks inconsistent with 64.8 kWh gross. Test car model year not stated. 90 km/h, 12 °C: 154 Wh/km. Other test seen, not recorded: Automobile-Propre (France) 18.8 kWh/100 km at constant 110 km/h, ~12 °C, winter tyres, 23.6 kWh/100 km at a 120 km/h motorway average with traffic..

heat_pump.notes: Page says the heat pump is “available”.
